gui.mechanical.tool_station.head: Head
gui.mechanical.kiln.unlit: Not lit: add fuel and light it with a Fire Drill
message.mechanical.kiln.needs_campfire: The kiln must be placed on a campfire
message.mechanical.kiln.needs_fuel: Put fuel in the kiln first
message.mechanical.knife_too_weak: This hide is too tough for your knife
message.mechanical.too_advanced: You don't know how to use this yet
message.mechanical.offering_altar.waitin: The altar waits for a worthy offering.
item.mechanical.thunderstone.lore: Struck from the sky, it calls the sky back down.
item.mechanical.mistletoe_charm.lore: Carried close, it mends wounds and turns poison.
item.mechanical.ancient_amber.lore: A sleeping insect; beasts take you for a quiet thing.
item.mechanical.heart_of_the_oak.lore: It still beats. Saplings wake at its touch.
item.mechanical.antler_crown.lore: See as the deer see; walk among them unnoticed.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.greet.hunte: Tread softly. The deer hear everything.
The herd went that way. Follow the blood, not the tracks.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.greet.gathe: The berries are sweet this moon.
Leave some for the bears, stranger.
Not the red mushroom with white spots. Never that one.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.greet.fishe: Quiet. You will scare the fish.
The river gives, if you are patient.
A bone hook and a good line. That is all you need.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.greet.woodc: Strong arms, sharp flint. Good wood.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.greet.elder: Welcome, stranger. The fire is warm, sit with us.
Bring me what you have. We will trade.
I have seen many winters. This one will be hard.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.greet.night: Stay close to the fire. Things walk in the dark.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.killer: Murderer! You will never be welcome here!
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.no_trade: We do not trade with you.
message.mechanical.blood_moon: The moon rises red... the dead are walking tonight.
message.mechanical.kiln.unfired: The clay is still raw: keep a fire burning in the kiln until it is fired
tribe.mechanical.name: %s Tribe
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.greet.frien: Welcome back, friend. Sit by our fire.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.warn: This is our land. Turn back, stranger, or bleed.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.gift: A gift? You are kind. We will remember.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.no_trade_st: We do not trade with strangers. Earn our trust first.
message.mechanical.pan.need_water: Pan in water: stand in it or aim at it
message.mechanical.flail.need_sheaf: Hold sheaves in your other hand to thresh them
message.mechanical.wind: The wind is rising... fires in the open won't last tonight.
tooltip.mechanical.crucible.empty: Empty: click Crushed Copper / Tin Ore, Concentrate or Native Copper onto it in your inventory
tooltip.mechanical.crucible.melts: Melts in a Clay Kiln at %s°
tooltip.mechanical.crucible.pour: Pour into a Clay Mold before it sets
tooltip.mechanical.crucible.remelt: Melt it again in a Clay Kiln
message.mechanical.mold.not_enough: This mold takes %s units of metal; the crucible holds %s
message.mechanical.mold.set_in_crucible: Too late: the metal has set in the crucible
message.mechanical.bellows.no_kiln: The bellows must blow into a Clay Kiln's firebox
message.mechanical.kiln.cracked: The kiln is cracked: press 4 Clay Balls into it, then fire it again
message.mechanical.kiln.patched: Patched: keep a fire burning to fire the new clay in
gui.mechanical.kiln.cracked: Cracked: no hotter than 600° until patched with %s Clay Balls
message.mechanical.straw_bed_rest: You rest a while in the straw. The night goes on.
message.mechanical.sanity.afraid: The dark presses in. Find a fire.
message.mechanical.sanity.mad: Your mind is slipping. Was that real?
message.mechanical.sanity.restless: You toss and turn. The shadows won't let you rest.
message.mechanical.dugout.burning: Let the fire burn out first
message.mechanical.dugout.needs_fire: Burn the hewn wood first (torch or fire drill)
message.mechanical.dugout.needs_axe: Hew it out with an axe first
message.mechanical.dugout.needs_knife: Smooth the hollow with a knife
message.mechanical.paintbrush.no_paint: Hold a bowl of paint in your other hand
message.mechanical.paintbrush.no_room: Paint needs a solid face with space in front
message.mechanical.paintbrush.no_room_sc: A scene needs two solid wall faces side by side
message.mechanical.camp.none: No camp here yet: keep a fire burning
message.mechanical.camp.age_noticed: This camp has burned for %s. Its smoke is seen far and wide...
message.mechanical.raid.drums: You hear drums in the dark, from the %s...
message.mechanical.raid.coming: War cries! Raiders of the %s come out of the dark from the %s, with torches!
message.mechanical.raid.defended: The raiders flee! They will think twice before coming back.
message.mechanical.furred_straw_bed_rest: You rest warm under the wolf pelt. The night goes on.
message.mechanical.too_far_gone: This is too far gone to keep
tooltip.mechanical.crucible.slag: %s%% tin: no bronze (8-15%% makes bronze, about 10%% the best). Melts as copper; the tin is lost as slag
tooltip.mechanical.crucible.tin_only: Tin alone casts nothing: add copper (about 9 copper to 1 tin)
message.mechanical.mold.wrong_metal: %s can't be cast in this mold
message.mechanical.drying_rack.pelt_need: This pelt needs a bigger rack
message.mechanical.drying_rack.pelt_no_r: There is no room for the pelt on this rack
message.mechanical.wheel.needs_clay: A %s takes %s Clay Balls (%s on the wheel); sneak with an empty hand to pick another shape
message.mechanical.wheel.enough_clay: There is enough clay on the wheel: hold right-click with an empty hand to throw it
message.mechanical.carcass.carry: On your shoulders. Right-click a block to put it down
message.mechanical.carcass.drag: Dragging it. Right-click it or a block to let go
message.mechanical.hanging_rack.too_big: Too big to hang. Butcher it where it lies
message.mechanical.cart.hitched: The horse is in the shafts. Right-click the cart again to unhitch
message.mechanical.horse.shies: The horse shies away. Crouch and hold out feed
message.mechanical.horse.trust: The horse eats from your hand (trust %s/%s)
message.mechanical.horse.ready_for_halte: It trusts you now. Put a Rope Halter on it
message.mechanical.horse.needs_halter: Put a Rope Halter on it before feeding it more
message.mechanical.horse.refuses_halter: The horse won't take the halter yet. Feed it first
message.mechanical.horse.haltered: Haltered. Keep feeding it to tame it (trust %s/%s)
message.mechanical.horse.tamed: The horse is tame. Right-click to ride, sneak + right-click for its gear
message.mechanical.travois.stuck: The travois is stuck. You let go of the poles
message.mechanical.travois.torn_loose: The poles slipped out of your hands
message.mechanical.cart.stuck: The cart is stuck. It came loose from the shafts
message.mechanical.cart.torn_loose: The cart came loose from the shafts
message.mechanical.crucible.too_hot: Let it cool before you knock it out
message.mechanical.carcass.hung: Hung %s min. Ages at 3 min; keeps about %s min more
message.mechanical.carcass.hung_aged: Hung %s min: aged and ready. Keeps about %s min more
message.mechanical.carcass.hung_spoiled: Hung %s min: the meat has spoiled
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.root.d: Bare hands. Pick up Loose Rocks and Loose Flint lying on the ground
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.plant_: Break grass and ferns for Plant Fibre (a knife triples the yield)
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.flint_: Craft a Flint Knife from Flint, Twine and a Stick. It stays in the grid as a tool
Craft a Flint Axe (2x2, fits the inventory grid). Logs need an axe
Craft a Flint Pickaxe. It also knaps rocks into stone tool heads
Craft a Flint Shovel or a Flint Hoe
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.firewo: Chop a tree with an axe: its logs split into Firewood
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.bark.d: Hold right-click with an axe on a Fallen Log to peel off Bark (tinder, bast, baskets)
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.bark_b: Craft a Bark Basket for berries, mushrooms and hides. Food keeps longer inside
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.tool_r: Put a knife above any Log in the crafting grid to carve a Tool Rod
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.pine_r: Right-click a Pine Log with a knife for Pine Resin. Resin over a Stick makes 2 Torches
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.stone_: Knap 3 rock chunks with the Flint Pickaxe into a Stone Pickaxe Head or Stone Axe Head
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.double: Knap two heads together with the Flint Pickaxe between them
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.tool_s: Build a Tool Station from a Flint Axe and a Flint Pickaxe. It joins head, binding and shaft
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.crude_: Tool Station: stone head + Twine + Stick makes a Crude Stone Pickaxe or Axe
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.stone_: Tool Station: Double Stone Pickaxe Head + Cordage + Tool Rod
Tool Station: Double Stone Axe Head + Cordage + Tool Rod
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.fire_d: Craft a Fire Drill from Twine and Sticks
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.campfi: Build a Campfire from Sticks and 3 Firewood. It is placed unlit
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.light_: Right-click an unlit Campfire with the Fire Drill. Leaf Litter or Bark as tinder first helps it catch
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.kiln.d: Craft a Clay Kiln (Clay Balls, rock chunks) and place it on a Campfire. Burn it 2 min at 500° before use
Bake a Clay Ball into a Brick in the kiln (600°)
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.charco: Bake a Log or 2 Firewood into Charcoal in the kiln. The hottest fuel
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.clay_b: Shape 3 Clay Balls into an Unfired Clay Bucket and fire it in the kiln. It only carries water
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.crucib: Fire an Unfired Crucible (7 Clay Balls) in the kiln at 800°: needs Charcoal or Bellows. The key to bronze
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.log_ra: Lash 6 logs together with 3 Cordage into a Log Raft
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.paddle: Carve a Rough Log into a Paddle with a knife
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.dugout: Mark a Fallen Log with a knife, then work it: axe, fire, axe, fire, axe, knife
Pick up Loose Red Ochre (badlands, savanna), Yellow Ochre (desert, rivers) or Chalk (shores, hills)
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.pigmen: Grind ochre, chalk or Charcoal with the Flint Pickaxe in the grid, or on a Stone Anvil
Mix 2 pigment with Tallow or water in a Bowl
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.cave_p: Paint in the off hand, right-click a wall with a Paintbrush (Stick + 2 Plant Fibre). Sneak to pick a motif
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.beaten: Walk the same way over grass a few dozen times until it wears into a Trodden Path. Paths are faster to walk on
Make a knife. Kill an animal and right-click its Carcass with the knife to butcher it
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.butch: Butcher a Carcass with a knife: hides and feathers first, then meat scraps
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.scrap: Scrape a Raw Hide with a knife in the crafting grid
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.dryin: Build a Drying Rack and right-click it with a Scraped Hide
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.leath: Take the dry Leather off the Drying Rack after about 3 minutes
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.bone_: Carve Fish Bones, a Bone or a Horn into a Bone Needle with a knife
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.armor: Craft an Armor Station from Leather, a Bone Needle, Planks and a Crafting Table
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.leath: Sew Leather and Wool Thread (or String) into Leather armor at the Armor Station
Sew 4 Leather into a Leather Satchel: 9 slots that go with you
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.travo: Lash 4 Tool Rods, 2 Cordage and a Scraped Hide into a Travois to drag big carcasses home
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.hangi: Build a Hanging Rack (5 Tool Rods, Cordage) and hang a carried carcass on it
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.prime: Butcher a carcass on the Hanging Rack: double meat as Haunch, Ribs and Loin
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.snare: Set a Snare (2 Sticks, Cordage) where small game walks. Bait it with berries or seeds
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.fishi: Fish with a Crude Fishing Rod (Tool Station: Flint + Twine + Tool Rod) or a Fish Trap
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.fish_: Craft a Fish Trap (6 Sticks, 2 Twine) and place it in open water, best in rivers
Gut a Whole fish with a knife in the crafting grid for fish and Fish Bones
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.bone_: Carve a Bone Fish Hook, then Tool Station: hook + Twine + Tool Rod
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.flint: Tool Station: Flint + Cordage + Tool Rod. Sprint and hold right-click to charge
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.crude: Tool Station: Cordage + Twine + Tool Rod makes a Crude Bow
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.arrow: Right-click a Fletching Table: Flint or bone + Stick + Feather makes 4 arrows
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.sinew: Fletching Table: Sinew + Crude Bow + Cordage. Full arrow damage
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.tallo: Cook Lard (Wild Boar) or Bear Fat on a Campfire into Tallow
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.candl: Craft Twine and 2 Tallow into Candles, light them with the Fire Drill
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.tusk_: Butcher a Wild Boar for a Tusk. Tool Station: Tusk + Cordage + Leather makes a Tusk Dagger
Kill a Brown Bear and butcher it with a Tusk Dagger (or bronze knife) for its pelt, fat and claws
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.bear_: Dry the Raw Bear Pelt on a tall Drying Rack outdoors by day (it takes the whole rack)
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.fur_a: Sew Bear Pelt and Sinew into Fur armor at the Armor Station. Each piece blocks 25 % of the cold
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.bear_: Craft a Bear Pelt and a Bear Claw into a Bear Rug
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.barbe: Fletching Table: Bear Claw + Stick + Feather
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.raw_w: Kill a Grey Wolf (they hunt at night and fear fire) and butcher it for a Raw Wolf Pelt
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.wolf_: Dry the Raw Wolf Pelt on a tall Drying Rack outdoors by day
Sew 2 Wolf Pelts and Sinew into a Wolf Hood at the Armor Station
Sew Wolf Pelts and Sinew into a Wolf Fur Coat, Leggings or Boots
Craft 2 Wolf Pelts and a Bone into a Wolf Rug. A pelt on a Straw Bed makes a warm Furred Straw Bed
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.phant: Kill a Phantom yourself and butcher it for Raw Phantom Hide
Scrape the hide and dry it on a Drying Rack, in daylight only
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.glide: Craft 4 Tool Rods, 2 Bones, Sinew and Cordage into a Glider Frame
Sew 6 Phantom Leather and the Glider Frame into a Glider Cloak at the Armor Station
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.ancie: Find the great hollow oak. Trails lead to it from the villages
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.giant: Hunt the rare Giant Deer for its Giant Antler
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.mythi: Offer the Giant Antler on the Offering Altar inside the Ancient Oak
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.undea: Kill a Brute: the rare huge zombie in a bearskin cape, slow but tough and hard to knock back
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.spear: Kill a skeleton charging with a Flint Spear. Now and then it drops the spear
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.tribe: Find a Tribe Village. Stay on good terms: camps that burn for days draw raiders
advancements.mechanical.food.root.title: Food & Farming
advancements.mechanical.food.root.descri: Pick wild berries, mushrooms or nuts. Fresh food spoils: raw meat in 1 day, berries in 2
advancements.mechanical.food.cooked.desc: Cook meat on a lit Campfire. Take it off with an empty hand before it burns
advancements.mechanical.food.burnt.title: Overdone
advancements.mechanical.food.burnt.descr: Leave food on the Campfire too long
advancements.mechanical.food.roasted.des: Roast mushrooms, hazelnuts or beechnuts on a Campfire
Boil an egg on the Campfire, then peel it in the crafting grid
advancements.mechanical.food.smoking_rac: Build a Smoking Rack (Sticks, Cordage) over or beside a burning Campfire
advancements.mechanical.food.smoked.desc: Hang raw meat or fish on the Smoking Rack for 4 minutes. Keeps 30 days
advancements.mechanical.food.dried.title: Sun-Dried
advancements.mechanical.food.dried.descr: Put raw meat, fish, berries or mushrooms on a Drying Rack outdoors by day (faster in full sun). Keeps 30 days
advancements.mechanical.food.spoiled.des: Let food spoil. A Bark Basket or a sealed Storage Jar slows it down
Cut Wild Einkorn or Wild Emmer with a knife, or pick Wild Peas
advancements.mechanical.food.sow.title: Sower
advancements.mechanical.food.sow.descrip: Till soil with a hoe and sow grain or peas on the farmland
advancements.mechanical.food.sheaf.title: Harvest
advancements.mechanical.food.sheaf.descr: Harvest a ripe crop for a Sheaf. A sickle gives bonus sheaves and Straw
advancements.mechanical.food.flail.title: Threshing
advancements.mechanical.food.flail.descr: Hold sheaves in the off hand and right-click a hard surface with a Flail for grain and Straw
advancements.mechanical.food.straw_bed.d: Craft a Straw Bed (3 Straw, 3 Planks) and right-click it to rest: sets spawn, keeps Phantoms away
advancements.mechanical.food.porridge.de: Mix 2 Grain, a Clay Water Bucket and a Bowl, then cook it on a Campfire
advancements.mechanical.food.manure.desc: Pick up Manure that livestock drop. Right-click farmland with it: fertility +2
advancements.mechanical.food.compost.des: Build a Compost Heap (Sticks, Leaf Litter, a copper ingot) and fill it with plant waste
advancements.mechanical.food.scarecrow.d: Build a Scarecrow (copper ingot bell, Carved Pumpkin, Straw, Raw Hide) to keep crows off the crops
advancements.mechanical.food.flour.title: Grind
advancements.mechanical.food.flour.descr: Build a Quern (Cobblestone, Stick, copper ingot axle) and grind Grain into Flour
advancements.mechanical.food.dough.title: Dough
advancements.mechanical.food.dough.descr: Mix 2 Flour and a Clay Water Bucket into Dough
advancements.mechanical.food.bread.title: Daily Bread
advancements.mechanical.food.bread.descr: Bake Dough on a Baking Stone beside a Campfire, or in the kiln at 200°
Look for green Malachite or Native Copper among loose rocks: copper ore lies below
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.raw_c: Mine Copper Ore with a stone pickaxe for Raw Copper
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.pan.d: Craft a Pan from Planks and Twine
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.panni: Right-click Gravel or Sand with the Pan, then hold right-click in water for Cassiterite and copper
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.stone: Craft a Stone Anvil from rock chunks and Cobblestone, with the Flint Pickaxe
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.crush: Put ore on the Stone Anvil and strike it 4 times with a pickaxe as hammerstone
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.conce: Hold an empty Pan and crushed ore in the other hand, use it in water. Worth double in the crucible
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.tuyer: Shape 3 Clay Balls into an Unfired Clay Tuyere and fire it in the kiln (600°)
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.bello: Craft Bellows, set it facing the kiln's firebox and pump it: +40° per click
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.molds: Shape Clay Balls into a mold and fire it in the kiln (600°)
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.molte: Click copper ore onto a Crucible and melt it in the kiln: copper needs 1085°
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.coppe: Pour the molten crucible into a Clay Ingot Mold within 60 s
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.rough: Pour molten copper into a tool head mold and take out the Rough Cast head
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.whets: Build a Whetstone from Sandstone, Sticks and Planks
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.sharp: Right-click the Whetstone 4 times with a Rough Cast head
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.coppe: Tool Station: Copper Pickaxe Head + Cordage + Tool Rod. It mines Tin Ore
Assemble a Copper Axe, Shovel, Hoe or Knife at the Tool Station
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.tin.d: Mine Tin Ore with the Copper Pickaxe and crush the Cassiterite on the Stone Anvil
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.bronz: Melt about 9 parts copper and 1 part tin in a Crucible at 950° and cast it
Cast, sharpen and assemble a Bronze Pickaxe. It mines Iron Ore
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.raw_i: Mine Iron Ore with a Bronze Pickaxe. The Iron Age awaits
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.bronz: Assemble a Bronze Axe, Shovel, Hoe or Knife (the knife can butcher bears)
Fire spear or sword molds, cast and sharpen, then assemble a Bronze Spear or Bronze Sword
Cast plates, sharpen them and sew a Bronze Helmet or Greaves at the Armor Station
Cast a saw blade and assemble a Bronze Saw. Log + Saw makes 4 Planks
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.potte: Build a Potter's Wheel (Planks, Bronze Saw, Bronze Ingot, Cobblestone)
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.stora: Throw 4 Clay Balls on the wheel and fire the jar. Sealed, food spoils 4x slower
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.water: Throw 3 Clay Balls on the wheel and fire the jug. Holds 6 pours
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.woode: Craft a Wooden Wheel: Planks, Tool Rods, a Bronze Ingot hub and the Bronze Saw
Build a Wheeled Cart from 2 Wooden Wheels, Planks and Tool Rods
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.rope_: Craft 3 Cordage into a Rope Halter. Sneak up to a Wild Horse and feed it grain to earn its trust
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.tame_: Halter a Wild Horse that trusts you and keep feeding it until it is tame
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.saddl: Craft a Hide Saddle Blanket (3 Leather, 2 Cordage) for full speed and jumps
